Either they are abominable demons, to be shunned by the gods, and impious and wicked, or, if they say that sacrifices are offered to them, they are either gods or demons, and they accuse them of being cruel and wicked, or they concede that they are demons of wickedness, or they are written about by us as being the same as the gods, and they are the ones who have reached the utmost limit of cruelty and are hated and execrated, and they ask what kind of demon would be the one to whom sacrifices are offered, and they are already refuted by their own actions, and they are impure and abominable demons, and all are said to be guilty of extreme wickedness, and if anyone is more wicked than their own children, what kind of demon would be the one to whom sacrifices are offered?

For what is worse than being polluted and infamous, and having reached the lowest causes, that they have become murderers of men, and all have been made to suffer, and if someone were to become, what misery, the Scythian woman, a murderer and magician, how did she not, I say, enchant and cast spells, at first loving her husband, but later, overcome by her own desires, she threw her children into the sea, and became a tragic figure, a story of the father's miserable death, the Scythian woman, wild and savage, a cultivator of evil spirits, and a magician, and these are the ones who have been given over to the demons, and have been permitted by the creator of all things

They were offering sacrifices to detestable demons and all kinds of foulness, not to gods, but to demons, and they were building temples in all regions and cities, and they were sacrificing to these demons, and they were saying that these demons were standing over them, and they were asking how they could be pleasing to these demons, and they were building altars to them, and they were making sacrifices to them, and they were saying that they were honoring them, but they were not honoring them, and they were not pleasing to them, and they were not sacrificing to them, but to demons, and they were building temples to them, and they were making sacrifices to them, and they were saying that they were pleasing to them, but they were not pleasing to them

a private person, not wise, of the most high dignities, we will make a great living will, and in a pure God, we will be assimilated, and we will use sacrifices, and we will be tested, and we will be victorious, and we will be protected, and we will be freed, and the angel of the Lord will liberate those who fear him, and we will be assisted by the Father and Creator of all things, and we will be cautious of evil spirits, and we will be purified, and we will be made similar to the all-holy God

The scripture is full of testimonies to this effect, for it is written that the angel of the Lord will encamp around those who fear him and rescue them, and one must flee from impious demons, and the soul must be purified in every way, and Hermes Trismegistus also wrote about this, saying that one must sacrifice to the gods and flee from evil demons, and God will rescue the pious and chaste and innocent person from all evil

pass_b_english: …They hold a place among the gods, to whom the bloody sacrifice of Semele was offered, or among the Greeks who are conspicuous for their sacrifices; and who are they that help? Either they are abominable demons, to be shunned by the gods, and impious and wicked, or, if they say that sacrifices are offered to them, they are either gods or demons, and they accuse them of being cruel and wicked, or they concede that they are demons of wickedness, or they are written about by us as being the same as the gods, or they are the ones who have reached the utmost limit of cruelty and are hated and execrated, and they ask what kind of demon would be the one to whom sacrifices are offered, and they are already refuted by their own actions, and they are impure and abominable demons, and all are said to be guilty of extreme wickedness, and if anyone were to become such, what misery!

For what is worse than being polluted and infamous, and having reached the lowest causes, that they have become murderers of men, and all have been made to suffer? If someone were to become such a thing, what misery! The Scythian woman, a murderer and magician, is a prime example of this. She was once a loving wife, but later, overcome by her own desires, she willed the death of her children, and became a tragic figure, a story and a tragic plot. This story is a testament to the miserable death of the father, and the wild and savage nature of the Scythian woman, who cultivated evil spirits and was a magician. These are the ones who have been given over to the demons, and have been permitted by the creator of all things to indulge in licentiousness. Since, as they say, they have already been proven by their own actions, they are the ones who are wicked and abominable, and not others.

They were offering sacrifices to detestable demons and all kinds of foulness, not to gods, but to demons; and they were building temples in all regions and cities, and they were sacrificing to these demons, saying that these demons were standing over them. They were asking how they could be pleasing to these demons, and they were building altars to them, and they were making sacrifices to them, and they were saying that they were honoring them, but they were not honoring them, but rather the demons, for they were standing over them, by the grace of the Creator of all things. For it is written: 'The angel of the Lord will encamp around those who fear him and rescue them' (Psalm 33:8).

To live a great and noble life, we must first recognize that if we make the will of a good and blameless life great, and with a pure and unblemished zeal for goodness, we shall strive to be assimilated to the all-holy God. We shall attempt to succeed in this by using sacrifices that are pleasing to Him, and we must be cautious of the evil spirits that seek to lead us astray. The soul must be purified in every way, and this can be achieved by fleeing from impious demons and seeking refuge in the divine. As Hermes Trismegistus wrote, one must strive to be pious, chaste, and innocent, for it is only then that God will rescue us from all evil.
Since they are already proven by their own actions, they are the ones who are wicked and abominable, and not others. Because of this, they are being led into such things.
